article.headline: Veteran Hollywood Publicist Leonard Morpurgo Dies at 93
article.summary: Leonard Morpurgo, the London-born international film publicist and communications executive who had senior posts at companies including Rogers & Cowan, Universal Studios, Columbia Pictures, CBS Theatrical Films and Lorimar Pictures, died of cancer on Aug. 12.
